name: Holding Rejection Reason 41 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the report item is rejected.

INPR.name: Invalid Price
INPR.definition: Price does not comply with the financial instrument's characteristics.

INID.name: Invalid Identification
INID.definition: Instruction contains an invalid message identification, identification is unknown.

INTE.name: Intermediary
INTE.definition: Intermediary is not recognised or is invalid.

CERT.name: Incorrect Certification
CERT.definition: Instruction is rejected since the provided certification is incorrect or incomplete.

BPAR.name: Business Partner Number Rejection
BPAR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid business partner number.

BREF.name: Bank Reference Number Rejection
BREF.definition: Unrecognised or invalid bank reference number.

DADR.name: Address Details Rejection
DADR.definition: Address details are incorrect or cannot be recognised.

IACT.name: Incorrect Activity Type
IACT.definition: Incorrect activity type specified, for example, pre-release conversion.

INVA.name: Invalid For Tax Authorities
INVA.definition: For tax reclaim, the reclaim is invalid for the tax authorities.

INDT.name: Invalid Details
INDT.definition: Message details specified in the instruction/request are inconsistent with those that were specified in the relating original message.

OPTI.name: Invalid Option
OPTI.definition: Invalid combination of corporate action option code and corporate action option number.

INMO.name: Invalid Movement Information
INMO.definition: Details specified in the movement general information block are inconsistent with those that were specified in the relating original message.

INUS.name: Invalid Underlying Security
INUS.definition: Underlying security identification does not correspond with the corporate action reference supplied.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.

ENDP.name: Missing Period End Date
ENDP.definition: Period ending date or code is missing.

STAR.name: Missing Period Start Date
STAR.definition: Period starting date or code is missing.

NOHO.name: No Holding
NOHO.definition: No holding for the specified underlying security.

NINS.name: No Instrument Market
NINS.definition: Referred instrument does not exist in combination with the mentioned market.

NOAP.name: Not Applicable
NOAP.definition: Instruction type is not applicable for mandatory events.

NAUT.name: Not Authorised
NAUT.definition: Permission to be processed is not granted.

AGID.name: Not Defined Agent
AGID.definition: Party is not defined as an agent.

DISP.name: Not Eligible Disperse Security
DISP.definition: Disperse security is not eligible in the (ICSD) service provider owner.

INPS.name: Place Of Safekeeping
INPS.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing place of safekeeping.

PLCE.name: Place Of Trade
PLCE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid place of trade.

PRIC.name: Price Exceeds
PRIC.definition: Price in the execution exceeds the order price.

IVAG.name: Receiving Agent
IVAG.definition: Receiving agent is not recognised or is invalid.

QUNP.name: Quantity Unit Type
QUNP.definition: Quantity unit type is not provided.

EQTY.name: Quantity Exceeds
EQTY.definition: Quantity in the execution exceeds the ordered quantity.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

NCRR.name: Settlement Amount Currency Rejection
NCRR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement amount currency.

SETR.name: Settlement Transaction Rejection
SETR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement transaction type.

UKWN.name: Unknown Symbol
UKWN.definition: Financial instrument's symbol has not been recognized.

INVB.name: Invalid Balance
INVB.definition: Instruction aims at using an invalid balance.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

INVE.name: Invalid Investor Party
INVE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid investor party. May be used by an executing party to reject an instruction for an investor (or portfolio) for which it is not authorised to act.

INUK.name: Investor Name Address Unknown
INUK.definition: Investor name and address is not recognised.

MINO.name: Minimum Settlement Quantity
MINO.definition: Quantity instructed is lower than the minimum existing settlement quantity for the financial instrument.

BOIS.name: Missing Beneficiary Owner Details
BOIS.definition: Rejected due to missing beneficiary owner details.

MCER.name: Missing Certification
MCER.definition: Certification has not been filled in.

IPOA.name: Missing Or Invalid POA
IPOA.definition: Missing or invalid power of attorney.

MUNO.name: Multiple Settlement Quantity
MUNO.definition: Quantity instructed is not a multiple of an existing settlement quantity lot for the financial instrument.

INNA.name: Narrative Information Rejection
INNA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid service level agreement pre-agreed narrative information.

NINV.name: No Inventory
NINV.definition: Requested financial instrument is not available.

PERI.name: Period End Date Before Start Date
PERI.definition: Period ending date is before period starting date.

REFE.name: Reference Rejection
REFE.definition: Instruction has a reference identical to another previously received instruction.

SAID.name: Same Identification
SAID.definition: Several messages with the same identification.

OWNT.name: Type Of Ownership Rejection
OWNT.definition: Type of ownership indicated is not correct.

NTAV.name: Not Available
NTAV.definition: Reason is not available or unknown.
